## What it is

**What it is:** A hierarchical note-taking app for building a personal knowledge base: nested notes, rich text and code, relation maps, scripting, encryption of single notes and sync between instances.

**Sub-tags:** notes, wiki (docs/design/TAXONOMY.md §1).

**Icon:** `icon.svg` is a neutral generated initials icon, not the upstream logo.

## How it is packaged

- **Image:** upstream `ghcr.io/triliumnext/trilium:v0.107.0` (the same digest as `docker.io/triliumnext/trilium`). `start-docker.sh` runs Trilium as the starting user when it is not root ("Kubernetes `runAsNonRoot`"); this pod starts as `node` (UID/GID 1000).
- **State:** PVC `trilium-data` (5 Gi) on `/home/node/trilium-data`: `document.db`, backups, logs.
- **Health:** probes on `GET /api/health-check`, the path the image's health script uses.
- **Security:** `runAsNonRoot`, `allowPrivilegeEscalation: false`, all Linux capabilities dropped, `RuntimeDefault` seccomp, no service-account token. One replica with the `Recreate` strategy, so two pods never write the same volume.

## First run

From the upstream documentation, https://docs.triliumnotes.org/:

1. Open the web UI (port 8080).
2. Choose to start a new document (or to sync from another Trilium server) and set the password.

## Known limits in this package

- Upstream's compose mounts the host's `/etc/timezone` and `/etc/localtime`; this package does not touch the host, so the server runs in UTC.
<!-- onemind:notes:end -->
